bio: Dating back to 1721, Cookridge Hall is located in the outskirts of Leeds between Horsforth and Bramhope. Sat amongst the surrounds of an 18 hole golf course it is the perfect place to indulge in an Afternoon Tea.  You and your companion can choose to be on the patio overlooking the formal garden or in the elegant conservatory.  Your Afternoon Tea will be served by the attentive staff describing each finger sandwich and accompanying treat alongside the traditional scone. Those feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of Prosecco or a refreshing peach Bellini.
